name: price-path
title: Moving WOOD price
question: What does a year on a moving WOOD price do to the lockup?
note: WOOD demand is USD-denominated, so the WOOD quantity is exactly inversely proportional to price. The reported lockup is the 12-month mean; binding TVL uses the WORST (lowest-price) month, because that is the month the constraint actually binds in. A re-rating relieves the constraint slowly and a crash tightens it immediately.
